# DASPA

> DASPA (daspa.com.au) is a done-for-you DASP claim service: it recovers
> Australian superannuation for people who worked in Australia on a temporary
> visa and have left. A registered tax agent finds every super fund in the
> client's name (including ATO-held money), prepares and lodges the Departing
> Australia Superannuation Payment application, and chases it until the money is
> paid to the client's bank account anywhere in the world. Operated by
> Australian Registration Office Pty Ltd, ABN 58 645 964 156, Registered Tax
> Agent 26076969 (verifiable on the Tax Practitioners Board register).

Key facts (current as of July 2026):
- Flat fee $149 + GST ($163.90) — never a percentage of the super balance
- No super, no fee: the fee is refunded in full if no super can be recovered
- The 5-minute online form accepts "I don't know my fund" — locating every
  account is the core of the service
- Identity verified electronically with passport + selfie — no certified
  copies or notaries
- Complete applications are typically paid within 28 days
- DASP tax rates are set by legislation and withheld by the fund or ATO —
  identical whichever agent (or no agent) is used; the ATO also offers a free
  DIY application system at ato.gov.au
- A paper form option exists: DASPA's fillable PDF version of ATO form NAT 7204,
  returned via daspa.com.au/upload-form
- Eligibility: worked in Australia on a temporary visa (417, 462, 482, 500 and
  others), departed, and the visa has expired or been cancelled
